name: 레어코일
scene: On a polished industrial testing terrace at sunset, a stable front three-quarter standing stance, both hands open at her sides. Silver geometric architecture and amber rim light.

Silver sleeveless high-neck fitted travel top and red high-waisted tailored Bermuda shorts, blue slim belt, white low sneakers, bare shoulders arms and lower legs, tiny three-circle brooch.

In an elegant apartment walk-in dressing alcove at late evening, leaning lightly against a console and arranging three small earrings in a velvet tray. Hands separately visible, warm wall lights and cool window reflections.

Fully opaque lined slate-blue satin longline camisole with secure double straps and scalloped silver trim, matching high-waisted tap shorts with full intimate coverage, bare arms shoulders midriff and legs.

At an airy aerial-yoga studio in golden afternoon light, standing and stretching both forearms horizontally while a loose fabric hammock hangs well behind her. Hands fully within the frame, no suspension or upside-down pose.
Red opaque racerback athletic crop top with secure broad straps, blue high-waisted full-length leggings, silver wristband. Bare arms shoulders and midriff.
